description: List, add, update and delete records in your Airtable bases.

airtable_new_or_updated_record_trigger.description: Runs for each record added to a table, and again each time someone changes one of its fields. Fields Airtable works out itself, such as formulas and lookups, don't count as a change. Records added or changed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. In beta, to start only when a record is marked a certain way (when Status becomes Ready to publish), fill in Only when this field and Is this value instead of adding an If step: the workflow then starts once when a record comes to hold that value, and not again for other edits to it.

output.created_time: When the record was added, as machine text such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00.000Z.
output.fields: The record's fields by name, such as Name or Status. Empty fields are left out.
output.id: The record's ID, such as recA1b2C3d4E5f6G7, for a later Airtable step.
output.record_link: Beta. A link that opens the record in Airtable, such as https://airtable.com/appA1b2C3d4E5f6G7/tblA1b2C3d4E5f6G7/recA1b2C3d4E5f6G7, ready for a message. Empty when the table can't be looked up.

parameters.description: The base the table is in.
parameters.name: base_id

parameters.description: The table to watch for new and changed records.
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.description: Beta. The name of one field to watch, such as Status. The workflow then starts only for a new record or a change to this field, not for edits to other fields. It must be a field people fill in, not a formula or lookup. Leave blank to start for every change.
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.description: Beta. With Only when this field: the value to wait for, such as Ready to publish. The workflow starts once when a record's field changes to this value, or a record is added with it, and not again while it stays there, so no If step is needed. Capitals and spaces around it don't matter. For a checkbox enter yes or no; for a field with several choices, it matches when this is one of them. Leave blank to start whenever the field changes.
parameters.name: field_value

airtable_new_record_trigger.description: Runs for each new record added to a table.
